underlines.text: she would find me in every respect ill qualified for the situation

reference.text: You will find her manners beyond anything I can describe; and your wit and vivacity, I think, must be acceptable to her, especially when tempered with the silence and respect which her rank will inevitably excite.

underlines.text: your modesty, economy, and other amiable qualifications

reference.text: Choose properly, choose a gentlewoman for my sake, and for your own; let her be an active, useful sort of person, not brought up high, but able to make a small income go a good way.
